author: Inside Edition
description: Erin Sloan and seven other passengers had a scare when their Uber shuttle caught fire going from New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport to Times Square. She told KCBS that police escorted everyone across the street as the flames intensified. Erin says Uber contacted her after she shared the video on social media, and offered her a $19 refund for her ride and a $50 credit to her account. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Uber Airport Shuttle Catches Fire With 8 Passengers Inside

author: Inside Edition
description: A man took his dog outside to go to the bathroom and saw a raccoon in his yard. Seconds later, the raccoon attacked. As the raccoon charged at the pug, RoRo, owner Sean Yanes tried to get the beast off the dog but it would not let go. Yanes’ wife Ashley saw what was happening and jumped in to help. The raccoon took off down the backyard slope where Sean was able to get the raccoon in a headlock and released it from RoRo. Inside Edition spoke with the couple.
title: Couple Fights Off Raccoon To Save Family Pug

author: Inside Edition
description: Tiger Woods' girlfriend Vanessa Trump showed her support following the golf star's arrest for DUI. Woods has been close to the Trumps for years. President Trump awarded Woods the Presidential Medal of Freedom during his first term. Woods has mentored Vanessa's daughter Kai in her budding golfing career. Minutes after last Friday's crash, Woods told authorities he spoke to the president, as revealed in a deputy sheriff's bodycam video. Woods has pleaded not guilty to DUI.
title: Vanessa Trump Shows Support For Tiger Woods Following DUI Arrest

author: Inside Edition
description: Gerhardt Konig, the doctor accused of trying to throw his wife, Arielle Konig, off of a cliff, faced a grilling on the stand by the prosecution. Prosecutors showed a photo of the trail in Hawaii from a travel article the doctor had looked at before going on the hike. Prosecutors also showed him the rock he used to hit his wife. The doctor claims she hit him first and was acting in self-defense. Gerhardt has pleaded not guilty to attempted murder.
title: Doctor Faces Cross Examination At His Attempted Murder Trial
